points.statement: The approach simultaneously maps and spatially correlates key sensor properties.
points.quote: simultaneous mapping and spatial correlation of key properties

points.statement: Optical excitation pathways are exchanged using a flipper mirror between epifluorescent and full-sample options.
points.quote: optical excitation pathways are exchanged by use of a flipper mirror

points.statement: Microwaves are coupled into an edge inductive gap.
points.quote: Microwaves (MWs) are coupled in to an edge inductive gap

points.statement: An avalanche photodiode and optical spectrometer connect to the above-sample collection pathway.
points.quote: The avalanche photodiode (APD) and optical spectrometer are coupled to the above-sample collection pathway.

points.statement: A below-sample objective feeds a long-pass filter and camera for spatially resolved imaging.
points.quote: The below-sample objective is coupled to a long-pass filter and camera used to image PL for spatially resolved NV characterization.

points.statement: A transmission measurement of optical birefringence is created using the same below-sample objective and camera.
points.quote: to create a transmission measurement of optical birefringence using the same below-sample objective and camera

points.statement: Photoluminescence is collected by an imaging objective beneath the sample and directed to a camera for wide-field imaging.
points.quote: the PL can be collected by an imaging objective mounted beneath the sample space, which directs light to a camera for wide-field imaging.

points.statement: Co-registering measurements simplifies analysis of complex features appearing across modalities.
points.quote: Measurements are co-registered to simplify analysis of complex features that appear across modalities.
